title: Not enough bang for the buck? Where’s the catnip and mousies?
text: A great idea but poor products. My cats can smell catnip from across the yard. They never even investigated the 2 boxes we received! I sat it in front of them and they walked away. Not good!! Toys were lame except for one that one of my cats has gone back to a few times. Shouldn’t all of the toys have catnip?  The one pack of treats we got were well received.
label: negative
